verdict.rationale: Stark Bank is a banking API, so faster-rails money movement is a fair axis. The evidence only documents Brazilian rails (Pix and TED transfers) and says nothing about US domestic wires, RTP or FedNow origination or receipt. It also has no per-rail capability documentation for those rails, and Pix/TED cannot stand in for the specific rails the story names.

support.subject: As a developer, the faster rails are there when I need them — domestic wires, RTP, and FedNow origination and receipt through the same API, with per-rail capabilities documented
